title: Looking for a Handsome Carpenter! Debiasing GPT-3 Job Advertisements

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model occupational priors using zero-shot prompts to predict gender tokens for specific jobs, and measuring text-level bias in generated job advertisements using a composite score based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) of six established lexicons of gender-laden words (e.g., gender-coded words, superlatives, connotation frames, and valence/arousal/dominance scores).
